newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Peronist hopeful's lead shrinks in Argentine poll.
newsitem.headline: Peronist hopeful's lead shrinks in Argentine poll.

text.p: Center-left candidate Graciela Fernandez Meijide narrowed the lead of Hilda Duhalde of the governing Peronist party ahead of October mid-term elections for Congress, according to a poll published Thursday.

Hilda, wife of Buenos Aires Province Governor Eduardo Duhalde, garnered 33.8 percent against 32.9 percent for Fernandez Meijide of the FREPASO party, according to pollsters Hugo Haime, Pagina/12 newspaper said.
The two are facing off in the race for the Chamber of Deputies seat for the province of Buenos Aires.
Fernandez Meijide had lagged Hilda Duhalde by between four and nine percentage points in previous surveys.
Former President Raul Alfonsin of the centrist Radical Party was well behind both candidates with 11.9 percent.
Three other candidates together attracted 6.7 percent, while 14.7 percent had no preference or did not respond. ((-- Guillermo Haskel, Buenos Aires Newsroom, 541 318-0650))
